_about: Storyboard of the evaluator-facing end-to-end demo in images/generated/demo/.
Every still named here is a TRACKED capture from a live run (physical D435 frames of the
whole-scene run of 2026-09-12, Isaac frames of that run and of the cut-and-place run of
2026-09-12, dashboard panels of the cut-aware decision for the same scenario); the assembler
records nothing and refuses a missing still. `seconds` is the duration in the long asset,
`short_seconds` in the README cut (0 = not shown there). `subs` change the subtitle at a
given source-frame offset of a sequence.
`below_banner` fits a still under the title band instead of behind it (dashboard panels).
